title: Refine interaction depth and micro-typography for compact components
creator: Aisha K. Patel
description: Problem: Compact / dense layouts in the Console (table rows, compact sidebars, action bars) exhibit visual crowding: current type micro-scale, corner radii, and shadow steps produce inconsistent perceived depth across components and make hover/focus states hard to parse. Goal: propose a constrained token subset optimized for compact surfaces that improves tap/hover affordance, preserves legibility at small sizes, and reduces visual noise while keeping accessible contrast. Scope: tokens (palette ramps, micro typography steps, spacing/radius scale, elevation/shadow micro-variants), component adjustments for Button/Tag/TableRow/Toolbar in compact variants, migration plan and rollout guide. Acceptance criteria: 1) New token map defined as --rdw-compact-type-{xs,sm,md}, --rdw-compact-radius-{0,2,4}, --rdw-compact-elevation-{none,low,medium}; 2) Visual tests for Table rows at 12px/13px pass AA contrast and visual density checks; 3) Migration guide with examples and a canary flag for console-compact theme; 4) Implementation checklist for frontend and design tokens repo; 5) Designer and Eng sign-off recorded in ticket.
steps: Audit current token usage across console components (tables, buttons, toolbars, tags)
Create micro-type scale variants with 12/13/14px sizes and line-height guidance
Define 3-step compact radius scale and 3 elevation micro-variants with usage rules
Prototype in Figma with component variants and run contrast checks
Partner with engineering to create token aliases and migration shims
Ship a behind-a-flag rollout to 10% of internal users, collect metrics and qualitative feedback
decisions: Adopt a reduced micro-typography scale (12/13/14px) rather than fractional scaling to limit layout thrash
Limit compact elevation to three tiers: none (flat), low (subtle 1px ambient), medium (soft 2px lift) to avoid heavy drop-shadows
Standardize compact radii to 0/4/8px (tokenized) for predictable corner rhythm across dense lists and inputs
Prefer color ramp adjustments (subtle tint shifts) over heavier shadows to convey hierarchy in very dense UIs for better printing and PDF snapshots
implementation_notes: Elevation tokens map to CSS variables with layered shadows: --rdw-compact-elevation-none, --rdw-compact-elevation-low, --rdw-compact-elevation-medium
Provide alias tokens in tokens.json and a migration map: {"--rdw-btn-radius": "--rdw-compact-radius-2"} (aliases to be consumed by frontend)
Frontend hooks: add 'compact' boolean to ThemeProvider, expose 'compact' class on body for scoped overrides
Performance consideration: prefer box-shadow-lite presets; avoid heavy blur values that harm GPU compositing on low-end devices
